import 'package:state_kit/state_kit.dart';
import 'package:flutter/widgets.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_config.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/app_scope.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/core/kind_art.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/data/models/item_kind.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_bloc.dart';
import 'package:sample_app/features/onboarding/onboarding_state.dart';
import 'package:kit_ui/kit_ui.dart';

/// Step 1: which items to track.
class PickPage extends StatefulWidget {
  const PickPage({super.key});

  @override
  State<PickPage> createState() => _PickPageState();
}

class _PickPageState extends State<PickPage> {
  final TextEditingController _search = TextEditingController();
  final ScrollController _scroll = ScrollController();
  final GlobalKey _header = GlobalKey();

  @override
  void dispose() {
    _scroll.dispose();
    _search.dispose();
    super.dispose();
  }

  Widget _tile(
    ItemKind kind,
    OnboardingState state,
    OnboardingBloc bloc,
  ) => KitItemTile(
    name: kind.commonName,
    selected: state.selected.contains(kind.id),
    onTap: () => bloc.add(KindToggled(kind.id)),
    art: KindArt(
      kind: kind,
      sway: false,
      cheerTick: state.cheerTicks[kind.id] ?? 0,
    ),
  );

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    final bloc = context.read<OnboardingBloc>();
    final catalog = AppScope.of(context).catalog;
    return BlocSignalBuilder<OnboardingBloc, OnboardingState>(
      builder: (context, state) {
        final listing = _Listing.of(state, catalog.kind, catalog.search);
        final count = state.selected.length;
        final dockCount = count < AppConfig.freeItemLimit
            ? count
            : AppConfig.freeItemLimit;
        return Stack(
          children: [
            Column(
              children: [
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
                  child: KitTopBar(
                    onBack: () => bloc.add(const BackPressed()),
                    center: const KitProgressDots(step: 1, count: 4),
                    trailingLabel: 'Skip',
                    onTrailing: () => bloc.add(const SkipPressed()),
                  ),
                ),
                Expanded(
                  child: KitRivePanel(
                    clipBelow: _header,
                    repaintOn: _scroll,
                    child: CustomScrollView(
                      controller: _scroll,
                      slivers: [
                        SliverPadding(
                          padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                            KitSpace.l,
                            6,
                            KitSpace.l,
                            0,
                          ),
                          sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
                            child: Column(
                              crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.start,
                              children: [
                                Semantics(
                                  header: true,
                                  child: KitBalancedText(
                                    'Which items do you want to track?',
                                    style: KitType.title.copyWith(color: c.ink),
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 6),
                                Text(
                                  'Pick a few to start. You can add more '
                                  'anytime.',
                                  style: KitType.secondary.copyWith(
                                    color: c.ink2,
                                  ),
                                ),
                                const SizedBox(height: 16),
                              ],
                            ),
                          ),
                        ),
                        SliverPersistentHeader(
                          pinned: true,
                          delegate: _FilterHeader(
                            controller: _search,
                            state: state,
                            onQuery: (q) => bloc.add(SearchChanged(q)),
                            onFilter: (f) => bloc.add(FilterSelected(f)),
                            ground: c.ground,
                            headerKey: _header,
                          ),
                        ),
                        for (final section in listing.sections) ...[
                          if (section.title != null)
                            SliverPadding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                                KitSpace.l,
                                16,
                                KitSpace.l,
                                0,
                              ),
                              sliver: SliverToBoxAdapter(
                                child: KitSectionHeader(
                                  section.title!,
                                  meta: section.meta,
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          SliverPadding(
                            padding: const EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
                              KitSpace.l,
                              10,
                              KitSpace.l,
                              0,
                            ),
                            sliver: SliverList.builder(
                              itemCount: (section.kind.length + 2) ~/ 3,
                              itemBuilder: (context, row) => Padding(
                                padding: const EdgeInsets.only(
                                  bottom: KitSpace.gridGap,
                                ),
                                child: IntrinsicHeight(
                                  child: Row(
                                    crossAxisAlignment:
                                        CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
                                    children: [
                                      for (var col = 0; col < 3; col++) ...[
                                        if (col > 0)
                                          const SizedBox(width: KitSpace.gridGap),
                                        Expanded(
                                          child:
                                              row * 3 + col <
                                                  section.kind.length
                                              ? _tile(
                                                  section.kind[row * 3 +
                                                      col],
                                                  state,
                                                  bloc,
                                                )
                                              : const SizedBox.shrink(),
                                        ),
                                      ],
                                    ],
                                  ),
                                ),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        ],
                        if (listing.isEmpty)
                          SliverToBoxAdapter(
                            child: Padding(
                              padding: const EdgeInsets.all(KitSpace.xl),
                              child: Text(
                                'No items match "${state.query.trim()}".',
                                textAlign: TextAlign.center,
                                style: KitType.secondary.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
                              ),
                            ),
                          ),
                        const SliverToBoxAdapter(child: SizedBox(height: 168)),
                      ],
                    ),
                  ),
                ),
              ],
            ),
            Positioned(
              left: 0,
              right: 0,
              bottom: 0,
              child: _Dock(
                count: count,
                buttonCount: dockCount,
                onContinue: () => bloc.add(const ContinuePressed()),
              ),
            ),
          ],
        );
      },
    );
  }
}

class _Section {
  const _Section(this.kind, {this.title, this.meta});

  final List<ItemKind> kind;
  final String? title;
  final String? meta;
}

class _Listing {
  const _Listing(this.sections);

  factory _Listing.of(
    OnboardingState state,
    List<ItemKind> all,
    List<ItemKind> Function(String) search,
  ) {
    final query = state.query.trim();
    if (query.isNotEmpty) {
      final found = search(query);
      return _Listing([
        _Section(
          found,
          title: found.length == 1 ? '1 match' : '${found.length} matches',
        ),
      ]);
    }
    return switch (state.filter) {
      ItemFilter.popular => _Listing([
        _Section(all.take(9).toList()),
        _Section(
          all.skip(9).toList(),
          title: 'More items',
          meta: 'A to Z by type',
        ),
      ]),
      ItemFilter.easy => _Listing([
        _Section([
          for (final s in all)
            if (s.difficulty == 'easy') s,
        ]),
      ]),
      ItemFilter.lowMode => _Listing([
        _Section([
          for (final s in all)
            if (s.lowModeOk) s,
        ]),
      ]),
      ItemFilter.shared => _Listing([
        _Section([
          for (final s in all)
            if (s.shared) s,
        ]),
      ]),
    };
  }

  final List<_Section> sections;

  bool get isEmpty => sections.every((s) => s.kind.isEmpty);
}

class _FilterHeader extends SliverPersistentHeaderDelegate {
  _FilterHeader({
    required this.controller,
    required this.state,
    required this.onQuery,
    required this.onFilter,
    required this.ground,
    required this.headerKey,
  });

  final TextEditingController controller;
  final OnboardingState state;
  final ValueChanged<String> onQuery;
  final ValueChanged<ItemFilter> onFilter;
  final Color ground;
  final GlobalKey headerKey;

  static const double _height = 48 + 12 + 40 + 4;

  @override
  double get minExtent => _height;

  @override
  double get maxExtent => _height;

  @override
  Widget build(
    BuildContext context,
    double shrinkOffset,
    bool overlapsContent,
  ) => ColoredBox(
    key: headerKey,
    color: ground,
    child: Column(
      crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
      children: [
        Padding(
          padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
          child: KitInput.search(
            controller: controller,
            hint: 'Search items',
            onChanged: onQuery,
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 12),
        SizedBox(
          height: 40,
          child: ListView(
            scrollDirection: Axis.horizontal,
            padding: const EdgeInsets.symmetric(horizontal: KitSpace.l),
            children: [
              for (final (filter, label) in [
                (ItemFilter.popular, 'Popular'),
                (ItemFilter.easy, 'Quick start'),
                (ItemFilter.lowMode, 'Quiet'),
                (ItemFilter.shared, 'Shared'),
              ])
                Padding(
                  padding: const EdgeInsets.only(right: KitSpace.xs),
                  child: KitFilterChip(
                    label: label,
                    selected: state.filter == filter,
                    onTap: () => onFilter(filter),
                  ),
                ),
            ],
          ),
        ),
        const SizedBox(height: 4),
      ],
    ),
  );

  @override
  bool shouldRebuild(_FilterHeader old) =>
      old.state.filter != state.filter || old.ground != ground;
}

class _Dock extends StatelessWidget {
  const _Dock({
    required this.count,
    required this.buttonCount,
    required this.onContinue,
  });

  final int count;
  final int buttonCount;
  final VoidCallback onContinue;

  @override
  Widget build(BuildContext context) {
    final c = KitColors.of(context);
    const limit = AppConfig.freeItemLimit;
    final note = count == 0
        ? 'Free covers $limit items'
        : count > limit
        ? '$count selected · Plus covers more than $limit'
        : '$count selected · Free covers $limit items';
    final inset = MediaQuery.paddingOf(context).bottom;
    return Container(
      padding: EdgeInsets.fromLTRB(
        KitSpace.l,
        KitSpace.x3,
        KitSpace.l,
        inset > 0 ? inset + 8 : 24,
      ),
      decoration: BoxDecoration(
        gradient: LinearGradient(
          begin: Alignment.topCenter,
          end: Alignment.bottomCenter,
          colors: [c.fade, c.ground],
          stops: const [0, 0.34],
        ),
      ),
      child: Column(
        mainAxisSize: MainAxisSize.min,
        crossAxisAlignment: CrossAxisAlignment.stretch,
        children: [
          Text(
            note,
            textAlign: TextAlign.center,
            style: KitType.captionLarge.copyWith(color: c.ink2),
          ),
          const SizedBox(height: KitSpace.s),
          KitButton(
            label: count == 0
                ? 'Continue'
                : 'Continue with $buttonCount ${buttonCount == 1 ? 'item' : 'items'}',
            onPressed: count == 0 ? null : onContinue,
          ),
        ],
      ),
    );
  }
}
